primitives.name: Bot Detection Barrier
primitives.verbatim_quote: enforces rigorous Cloudflare Turnstile / Bot Management headers that block unauthenticated programmatic HTTP clients without full residential browser fingerprinting.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'B': 'Boolean indicator for bot detection (1 = detected, 0 = not detected)', 'F': 'Residential browser fingerprint (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Bot detection is modeled as a binary classification problem with fingerprinting as a sufficient condition for access.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When B=1, HTTP client access is denied; when F < threshold, B=1.

layer2.mapping: The barrier function maps to a conformal prediction set where valid access is a subset of all possible fingerprints.

primitives.name: Fallback Data Ingestion
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Remediation & Fallback**: - Ingest advanced passing metrics (hurries, blitzes, sacks, bad throw %) directly from the nflverse pre-scraped Parquet mirrors (`intelligence/coaching/data/advstats_week_pass_2026.parquet`), which are pre-ingested and verified.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M': 'Metric vector (hurries, blitzes, sacks, bad throw %)', 'D': 'Data source identifier (Parquet path)', 'V': 'Verification flag (1 = verified, 0 = unverified)'}
primitives.assumptions: Pre-scraped data is a reliable proxy for real-time metrics under access constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When V=0, fallback to D is triggered; M is invariant under transformation.

layer2.mapping: Ingestion kernel maps raw Parquet data to structured feature space for downstream analysis.
layer2.telemetry: Parquet file integrity check and metadata timestamp

primitives.name: Interactive Browser Session
primitives.verbatim_quote: - REA fallback module: `src/browser/CdpBrowserProvider.ts` with headful interactive browser session.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'Session type (headful = 1, headless = 0)', 'T': 'Time to session initialization (seconds)', 'R': 'Resource usage (MB)'}
primitives.assumptions: Headful sessions bypass bot detection by mimicking human interaction patterns.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S=1, T < threshold and R < limit, session is viable.
